title: Mapping Alaska's Forests
description: NASA and the U.S. Forest Service are surveying the forests of Interior Alaska. The airborne study using an advanced instrument will create a 3D map of the forest composition. This will enable scientists to see patterns of fire recovery and provide a benchmark for assessing future changes to the region.
keywords: Earth, Alaska, U.S. Forest Service, Forest Composition
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: NASA has taken to the skies of Alaska.
An airborne study conducted in partnership with the US Forest Service aims to complete
the detailed survey of the Tenana Valley Forest.
The 115 million acres of forest in Ontario, Alaska is particularly prone to wildfires
and represents 15% of all forested land in the US.
Since the 1950s, 40 to 50% of the landscape has been burned.
The study will sample more than 80% of the burned areas by plane.
Live trees can be distinguished from standing dead trees using an instrument that maps
the composition and 3D structure of the wilderness.
The measurements will enable scientists to see patterns of fire recovery
and provide a benchmark for assessing future changes to the region.
